narrative: On the tables. The tables are open on the desk. The west window is dark. Downstairs the house is only a house. He writes the address, and under it the work, and he does not write a name beside either. On the tables. The same leaf. The pen has stopped. There is room under the glass for a sentence, and the room stays empty. The chest is still to be opened tonight. The leaf does not say so.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the five items, and stopped.
